usage.finalMessage:
`reminders <date>` now works and `help` lists it straight after `reminder`; all 10 tests pass (`dotnet test Clinic.slnx`), committed as `732c173`. Reminders now use the 48-hour rule from DEC-C08, so `reminder <appointment>` gives a different answer than before, and I updated its existing test to match.
I did not implement a tie-break for appointments at the same time, since DEC-W-5 was rejected; it is an open question in `.work/report.json` (ties currently come out in id order only as a side effect, and no test checks it).
OUTCOME: completed
